item.title: What Is an E-Passport? Know What ‘E’ Stand for in E-Passport and Whether Upgrade Is Mandatory or Voluntary
item.description: An e-passport is a hybrid booklet featuring an embedded RFID chip that stores your biometric and personal data for enhanced security and faster immigration. While the Passport India website notes that all new applications now receive e-passports by default, it is not mandatory to replace your current valid passport until it expires. Scroll belwo to know more.

item.title: Mathura Horror: Man, Wife and 3 Children Found Dead in Village, Police Suspect Mass Suicide
item.description: Five members of a family were found dead in a village under the Mahavan police station area of Uttar Pradesh’s Mathura district, police officials said on Tuesday. Police suspect that this could be a case of mass suicide. The deceased include a man, his wife, and their three children.
